newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Newcrest posts March qtr A$7.1 mln net loss.
newsitem.headline: Newcrest posts March qtr A$7.1 mln net loss.

text.p: Newcrest Mining Ltd said on Wednesday it recorded a net loss of A$7.1 million in the March quarter, and forecast a small full year loss before abormals.

Newcrest said revenue in the March quarter was substantially reduced, and extra costs were incurred, following heavy rains which led to a six-week curtailment of mining activities at the Telfer gold mine in Western Australia.
"A small full year loss before abnormals is forecast as a result of the Telfer production losses," the company said in its quarterly report.
Newcrest reported a net profit of A$8.7 million for the nine months to March 31.
Group equity gold production for the quarter was 102,140 ounces, against 137,912 in the corresponding period last year.
Income from mining fell 64 percent to A$410.1 million.
Newcrest said some 20,000 ounces of gold was lost in the quarter due to the closure of the access road to Telfer and the milling of lower grade ore.
Suspension of all construction activity delayed work on leach pads, and would cause production shortfalls of up to 25,000 ounces over the next six months.
